body.id: 左 zuǒ = kiri, 右 yòu = kanan. 往左拐 wǎng zuǒ guǎi = belok kiri, 一直走 yīzhí zǒu = jalan lurus.
body.en: 左 zuǒ = left, 右 yòu = right. 往左拐 wǎng zuǒ guǎi = turn left, 一直走 yīzhí zǒu = go straight on.

body.id: Lampu lalu lintas: 红灯停，绿灯行。 Hóngdēng tíng, lǜdēng xíng. = Merah berhenti, hijau jalan.
body.en: Traffic lights: 红灯停，绿灯行。 Hóngdēng tíng, lǜdēng xíng. = Red means stop, green means go.

body.id: 坐 zuò untuk bus dan kereta, 骑 qí untuk sepeda: 我骑自行车去学校。 Wǒ qí zìxíngchē qù xuéxiào.

body.id: 下雨 xià yǔ = hujan turun. 下雨了！ Xià yǔ le! = Wah, sekarang hujan!
body.en: 下雨 xià yǔ = it rains. 下雨了！ Xià yǔ le! = Look, it's raining now!

body.id: Tiongkok punya empat musim. Indonesia punya dua: 雨季 yǔjì (hujan) dan 旱季 hànjì (kemarau).
body.en: China has four seasons. Indonesia has two: 雨季 yǔjì (rainy) and 旱季 hànjì (dry).

model_answer.id: Kompas dalam bahasa Mandarin: 指南针 zhǐnánzhēn, 'jarum penunjuk selatan' (指 zhǐ menunjuk, 南 nán selatan, 针 zhēn jarum). Pada abad ke-12, pelaut Tiongkok dan Eropa sudah memakai kompas magnet.
model_answer.en: In Mandarin a compass is 指南针 zhǐnánzhēn, a 'south-pointing needle' (指 zhǐ point, 南 nán south, 针 zhēn needle). By the 12th century, sailors in China and Europe were using magnetic compasses.

items.source: CC-CEDICT entry 指南针 zhǐnánzhēn "compass" (as shown at chinesenotes.com/words/13796.html) and its entries 指 "to point", 南 "south", 针 "needle"; Encyclopaedia Britannica, "Compass" (navigational instrument): "Sometime in the 12th century, mariners in China and Europe made the discovery, apparently independently" that a floating lodestone points to the polestar.
